composition.arrows: strict shared columns; square fields and aligned baseline rules; preserve actual directions and supported joins.
composition.people: The authored person mark follows strict shared columns; square fields and aligned baseline rules; no face or gender cues.
composition.empty: An unoccupied chair with explicit empty label; no body in its negative space.
composition.pending: Use the authored clock beside an explicit pending label; never infer completed status.
composition.emphasis: Accent identifies the teaching point; decorative structure never introduces facts.
composition.warning: Warning role accompanies literal warning text and a distinct mark, never color alone.

required.description: Construct related objects with strict shared columns; square fields and aligned baseline rules. Preserve this geometry when remapping palette.
Keep exact brief facts, counts and directions; separate empty, pending and complete. Inspect upright Japanese labels at actual placement.
Declare palette roles on every color-bearing mark. Ink carries readable content; surface is backing; border construction; accent emphasis; deep subordinate planes; warning explicitly labeled risk.

preferred.description: Keep labels outside small marks; use sparse subordinate geometry and generous negative space.

flexible.description: Change panel count, spacing, connectors and line breaks for the actual brief; this evidence composition is not a mandatory page template.
Author new silhouettes using this construction; explain intentional preferred-rule departures.
